name: Rainier Beach Youth Stewards
what_you_do: Work at the Rainier Beach Urban Farm and Wetlands. You help heal the wetland and teach about the farm. You also do team building, field trips and workshops.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 14 to 18. Crew members must be able to do heavy lifting and work in rain or shine.
deadline_text: Dates and deadline not posted on the page. Applicants are encouraged to apply for all seasons.
how_to_apply: The page does not list the steps to apply. Contact Suez Gebretsadik at (206) 633-0451 ext. 900 or suezgebretsadik@tilthalliance.org.
notes: Pay, dates and how to apply were not stated on the page. Confirm with the contact before you plan around it. These are temporary seasonal positions.
